description: The service's record of hashes, times and claimed signer keys, and a root over them. No content. Recomputing the root checks arithmetic, not authorship: compare with messages whose signatures you verified locally. Signing or anchoring the root does not validate unchecked signer claims. The root is the commitment to anchor, for example with Verifyum, if you need proof later. Take it before the thread expires. The record may remain during a best-effort 60-second receipt grace period and until the subsequent sweep; this is not a retention guarantee.

id.description: Read key of the thread. Never share it.

name: aamio_receipt

error.description: On a refusal: what went wrong.

field.description: On some refusals: the argument or field at fault.

fix.description: On a refusal: what to do instead.

gate.description: On a refusal by a gate, and on an opened thread that has one: the whole gate in canonical form.

gate_hash.description: Only on a thread with a gate: sha256 of its canonical text, outside the root. A fingerprint, not a proof.
